result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation in this food delivery app interface.

issues.description: Restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel are cut off at the right edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...' name is truncated), suggesting the card widths or padding are not accounting for the viewport edge cleanly.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container so the next card peeks consistently and text labels are not awkwardly clipped, or add proper ellipsis truncation with padding.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without a clear ellipsis, making the full name unreadable at first glance.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent text-overflow ellipsis styling to card titles so truncation is visually intentional.

issues.description: The two discount/delivery badges use inconsistent formats ('€0 delivery' vs '-0%'), which may confuse users. The '-0%' badge in particular implies no actual discount.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge messaging and avoid showing meaningless values like '-0%'; hide the badge if there is no real discount.
